baseline.answer: When candidates complete an application via API or by redirecting to your career site where our pixel is placed, Joveo tracks them by capturing an anonymized identifier—such as a candidate or applicant ID, depending on your ATS. We use this unique ID to match candidates and track their progress through various stages downstream. Crucially, Joveo only pulls data for applicant IDs generated through our platform, ensuring direct candidates who applied on your career site without Joveo's touch are not included.
baseline.quote: we capture, like in think of it as an anonymized ID, could be a candidate, ID, could be an applicant, ID could be like a system or person id, depending on the type of applicant tracking system it is, right? So we essentially match candidates and their stages based on that.

must: Answer at the same breadth as the question: an overview of how Joveo tracking works as a whole, not only down-funnel ATS stage attribution
Read as something a CSM could say on a sales or intro call
must_not: Narrow straight into one sub-topic (down-funnel ID matching) as if that were the whole of tracking
expected.also_acceptable: A short clarifying question about which part of tracking the client means (Naren's 4th overall recommendation), ideally alongside a brief overview

cases.question: Can Joveo get my ads on Craigslist? How is it going to be any better when compared to my team posting ads on Craigslist directly?
naren_said: Yeah, this is a really good answer.

baseline.answer:
Yes, Joveo can place your ads on Craigslist. In fact, Craigslist was one of Joveo's first products, backed by years of data across millions of job postings.

Here is why using Joveo is far more effective than posting directly:

- **Performance-Based (CPA) Pricing:** When posting directly, your team pays a flat fee per post and absorbs all the risk if it fails to yield results. Joveo converts Craigslist into a performance-based (cost-per-apply / cost-per-reply) model, shifting the risk away from you so you pay for actual candidate traffic and applications.
- **Automated Category & Market Optimization:** The platform uses historical data to select the right Craigslist markets and target the exact sections (e.g., job sections vs. gig sections) that deliver the best traction.
- **Frequency & Ad Copy Variations:** Rather than posting a single manual listing, Joveo automates posting schedules and can run multiple ad copy variations (for example, testing 5 variations in a single day) to capture maximum candidate attention.
baseline.quote: So typically, the model in which we convert this into is a performance based model, when we essentially look at Craigslist.

must: Yes, Joveo can post to Craigslist
Why it beats posting directly: performance-based (cost-per-apply) instead of flat fee per post; data-driven market/section selection; automated frequency and ad-copy variation
expected.note: Regression guard. Also the context for N1104-05.

cases.question: How do I get started with Joveo? What are the things I need to do on my end?
cases.context: Seventh message. He first thought of 'What does the onboarding process look like?' and reworded it to be more conversational.

ideally the answer should have been more about what our onboarding process looks like: we take two to four weeks to set you up, the onboarding process includes A, B, C steps -- versus getting too much into the specifics

baseline.answer:
To get started with Joveo's job feed setup and ingestion, follow this 5-step play in the order Naren typically executes it:

1. **Explain format adaptation between APIs, JSON, and XML feeds**: Clarify how non-XML formats (such as JSON payload arrays or API endpoints) are processed into a standardized feed format or replace an XML feed URL.
2. **Validate feed schema structures and metadata field requirements**: Review and identify required metadata attributes (such as job IDs, destination URLs, or location codes) in the feed payload prior to setup.
3. **Detail file transport protocols and update refresh intervals**: Establish the transport mechanism (such as an SFTP/FTP server) and define update cadences (such as hourly or 45-minute refresh cycles).
4. **Map feed XML nodes and tags to campaign budget structures**: Map specific XML elements or job group nodes to campaign budget structures, location tiers, or priority categories.
5. **Verify feed ingestion through staging environments and test instances**: Conduct testing by obtaining access to staging environments, running test ingestions, and validating job displays on demo or staging portals.
baseline.quote: Yep. So on our end as well, we'll map these elements out. Right? Like, we'll give you a a more complete checklist.

must: Give the onboarding process as a whole: the typical timeline (Naren: two to four weeks) and the main stages, at a high level
Treat the job feed as one component of setup, not the whole answer
must_not: Answer only with job-feed / XML setup steps
expected.also_acceptable: A clarifying question first -- 'get started with what? Are you looking to do programmatic?' -- which Naren suggested himself
expected.needs_outside_calls: The 2-4 week figure is Naren's; the list of stages may need documentation if his calls don't cover it end to end.

baseline.answer:
Here is the general play to set up campaign-level tracking and segmentation on Joveo. You should run the following moves in this order:

1. **Define Account Hierarchy and Campaign Allocation Parameters**: Establish the platform structural levels (Client/Account, Campaign, Job Group, Job) and outline operational requirements like dedicated channel budgets or geographic targeting.
2. **Establish Master Tracking Documents, UTM Generators, and Offline Reports**: Utilize offline reports, master spreadsheets, or UTM generator tools to track campaign assets, job boards, or dynamic naming conventions that are not directly isolated in standard dashboards.
3. **Enable API Extraction, Entity Mapping, and System Tracking Boundaries**: Set up stats APIs, define entity mapping logic between job groups and platform campaign IDs, and communicate system parameters like API pinging frequency or tracking start dates.
